title: Shamefaced

inlines.v: SHA'MEFACED, adjective Bashful; easily confused or put out of countenance. A man may be shamefaced to excess. Conscience is a blushing shamefaced spirit. Shak. Your shamefac'd virtue shunn'd the people's praise. Dryden.
